svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Bar = minimum of the samples (ms, linear axis per section), lighter extension to the median.
Label: ms · multiple of the fastest browser of the section (bold) · time per node.
Bars are stacked by stage where the engine records them, left to right in pipeline order (solid → faint); grey = rest of the span; the faintest tail is min → median; hover a segment for its value.
